title: Mental Health in Veterans and Families After Group Therapies
official: Mental Health in Veterans and Families After Group Therapies
summary: PTSD (posttraumatic stress disorder) and associated mental health conditions affect both veterans and their family members. This study investigates whether group therapy using EFT (Emotional Freedom Techniques) and CBT (Cognitive Behavior Therapy) produce reductions in PTSD and comorbid symptoms.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* The ability to follow instructions, complete written forms, and provide informed consent. Subjects are required to be literate and understand English.
* Physically healthy.
* Active duty military service, veterans, and their family members.

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
